title: Resin-Vat Clouding and Exposure Drift
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), Klipper resonance metrics (`klipper:telemetry`), resin print logs (`resinprint:job`), tool usage (`tool:usage`), filament inventory (`filament:spool`), and workshop air readings (`workshop:air`).
app: Maker telemetry from OctoPrint, Moonraker, printer firmware sensors, resin printer job logs, smart dryboxes, and workshop tool sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=resinprint:job
| stats avg(exposure_s) as avg_exposure_s avg(vat_clarity_pct) as avg_clarity_pct count as jobs by printer resin
| sort avg_clarity_pct
description: Correlates resin exposure settings with vat clarity so cloudy vats and creeping exposure compensation become obvious.
value: Resin printers often degrade slowly; tracking clarity and exposure together helps time maintenance before detail loss becomes severe.
implementation: Export resin job metadata with exposure settings and periodic vat-film clarity checks from maintenance logs.
visualization: Scatter plot of average vat clarity versus average exposure time by resin and printer.
grandmaExplanation: It maps when the resin vat is getting cloudy and the printer is needing longer exposures to cope with it.
